asset_inventory.role: read-only P04 provenance and asset inventory

objective: Diagnose whether the P04 D ranking loss produced measurable teacher-order learning and whether that signal conflicts with gold-token reconstruction, without fitting or evaluating a new model.

diagnostic_scope.gradient_cell_definition: selected H plus selected and final D for seeds 1737 and 2711, each at four predeclared schedule batches
diagnostic_scope.schedule_batch_geometry: exact original P04 schedule batches: six replay plus two correction records, with the recorded sparse teacher mask

input_availability.replay_schedule_and_records: available from P04 metadata and schedule artifacts; implementation must bind the six replay plus two correction batches before any diagnostic run
input_availability.public_correction_activations: available as inherited P04 public input; external large payload, referenced by asset_inventory
input_availability.public_validation_activations: available as inherited P04 public input; external large payload, referenced by asset_inventory
input_availability.teacher_pairs_and_candidate_cache: available as inherited P04 public evidence; external large payload, referenced by asset_inventory
input_availability.states: P04 selected/final S/H/D states available; one public affine initial-function reference available; no serialized initial GRU checkpoint

publication.finalization: Do not publish this scaffold as final; refresh after the diagnostic run and result report exist.
